# Password Generator 1.6.2

A unified native maintenance release for Android, Windows and macOS.

- Remediated known build-tool dependency vulnerabilities with Kotlin 2.4.20, R8 9.1.29 and patched transitive libraries; existing checksum trust is preserved.
- Added Windows clipboard-history/cloud exclusion and restored macOS Escape handling.
- Keep long revealed passwords fully readable in narrow Android layouts.
- Fixed the Android reveal/reset transition so replacement passwords are hidden before their first frame.
- Improved About scrolling, Windows keyboard navigation and desktop clipboard ownership checks while removing redundant secret copies.
- Fixed the macOS About version display.
- Added executed Android API 26/36 privacy tests, compiled APK/AAB contract checks and 16 KB package validation.
- Corrected protected signing-property escaping and generated-resource preparation for Qodana.
- Prepared the Google Play listing, media and submission checklist; no advertising, analytics, networking, accounts or password persistence were added.

Android packages use the permanent release signing certificate. Windows remains without Authenticode; macOS uses ad-hoc signing, without Developer ID or notarization. SHA-256 checksums and provenance attestations accompany release packages. R8 mapping is included for Android crash deobfuscation.

Publication in Google Play, Play App Signing enrollment and physical/internal-track acceptance are separate owner actions. A signed candidate artifact is not evidence of Google Play acceptance.
